title: Domestic Flights to/from Lukla
desc: Round-trip scheduled mountain flights (Kathmandu/Ramechhap to Lukla and Lukla to Kathmandu) including all airport passenger taxes.

title: 15 kg Flight Baggage Allowance
desc: Full 15 kg baggage allowance per passenger on Lukla flights (10 kg check-in duffle + 5 kg hand-carry daypack).

title: All National Park & Local Permits
desc: Sagarmatha National Park entry permit and Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality entry permit with pre-arranged paperwork.

title: 6 Nights Mountain Teahouse Accommodation
desc: Authentic mountain lodges (twin-sharing rooms) with cozy dining rooms: Phakding (2 nights) and Namche Bazaar (3 nights), Lukla (1 night).

title: Licensed English-Speaking Sherpa Guide
desc: Government-certified, wilderness first-aid-trained local Sherpa guide managing trail safety, lodge check-ins, and cultural briefings.

title: Dedicated Porter Support
desc: 1 porter for every 2 trekkers (carrying up to 20–25 kg total, max 12.5 kg per trekker), allowing you to walk with a light daypack.

title: Staff Insurance & Fair Wages
desc: Full insurance coverage, fair wages, meals, lodging, and high-altitude equipment for our guide and porter support team.

title: All Meals on Trek (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)
desc: Three hearty meals daily selected from lodge menus, accompanied by hot tea or coffee with each meal and fresh fruit after dinner.

title: Medical Kit & Oximeter Monitoring
desc: Comprehensive first-aid kit and twice-daily digital pulse oximeter blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) and heart rate monitoring.

title: Airport Transfers & Duffle Bag
desc: Private airport pickup and drop-off in Kathmandu, plus a complimentary Namaste Hiking Trek branded 80L waterproof trekking duffle bag.
